nom: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tea-Trica Spot Cream

segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including oily T-zone with dry patches elsewhere, report this spot cream doesn't cause the peeling or flaking that other acne treatments usually trigger for them, and doesn't over-dry or over-moisturize.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one in her 60s, find the cream gentle and appropriately light, with one saying the amount dispensed suits dry skin well.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers report the cream is gentle enough for sensitive areas, doesn't sting or overly dry the skin, and is recommended by others specifically for sensitive skin.
segments.mature: One 63-year-old reviewer with dry, sensitive, acne-prone skin calls it the most effective yet gentle blemish product she's used, saying it transformed her skincare routine.

concerns.blemishes: Nearly all reviewers report the cream speeds healing and visibly flattens or shrinks blemishes, often overnight to within a few days, including some managing hormonal or cystic-adjacent breakouts; the main dissent is one reviewer who found it only effective on pimples that had already come to a head or were mild, with no real effect on deep or emerging cystic acne.
concerns.redness: Reducing redness is one of the most consistently reported effects, with many reviewers noticing calmer, less inflamed skin within hours to overnight; one reviewer with severely irritated, barrier-damaged skin after a chemical peel says it brought noticeable relief and reduced redness within a few hours.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say the cream is lightweight and not drying, even with regular use; a couple note it can be slightly drying if overused or applied beyond the blemish itself, which one reviewer specifically welcomed as it dried out her problem areas faster.
concerns.spots: Reports on dark spots and post-acne marks are mostly positive — several reviewers describe fading of sun spots, dark marks, or hyperpigmentation with regular use, and one specifically avoided her usual post-inflammatory marks after treating a breakout with it; one reviewer, however, felt it made no difference to her dark spots at all.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer applied this to skin with a severely compromised barrier after a chemical peel and reports immediate cooling relief and eased pain, with visible improvement within hours; more broadly, reviewers describe the formula as calming rather than irritating even on compromised or reactive skin.

aspects.libelle: Absorbs fully rather than staying concentrated on spots
Small tube, pricier for frequent use

extraits.texte: The product feels great on the skin! I feel it has a cooling sensation when applied which I enjoy! Overall great product!

This spot treatment is unusual in that it focuses more on fighting irritation and inflammation versus clearing the pore. It feels lightly hydrating and absorbs fast, though I like to massage spot treatments in for around 15 seconds to make sure it really sinks in. The ingredients, especially panthenol, are excellent at calming and protecting skin, which is definitely helpful during a breakout. I used this spot treatment on a number of pimples and noticed the biggest difference on ones that had come to a head or were already drying out. It seemed to really speed along the healing process and made my acne less visible by reducing redness and inflammation. I didn't experience any dryness or flakiness though with how gentle these ingredients are that didn't really surprise me. Unfortunately, this spot treatment didn't do much for deep or emerging pimples. It wasn't strong enough to clear blocked pores and was really only effective on "mature" or very mild acne. If you struggle mainly with cysts, this isn't the spot treatment for you!

extraits.titre: Calm and soothing on skin, would repurchase
extraits.texte: ​I received this product for review, but I've spent my own money on other products from this line before, so I already had high hopes. ​My skin is combo with an oily t-zone and dryness everywhere else, so spot treatments usually just end up making me peel. This one was different. It's gentle and didn't irritate my skin or leave me with those dry, flaky patches that usually come with acne creams. I find that the cream also doesn't just sit on the skin, but does sink into the skin. This is where I docked a star though, because while I like that it does sink into the skin, it sort of defeats the purpose of it being a concentrated spot treatment. ​I don't get a ton of breakouts, so I don't reach for a spot treatment every single day, but it's been a great option to have on hand. If you have mild to moderate acne and want something that won't wreck your skin barrier, it's definitely worth a look. The only thing I'd flag is the size; the tube is pretty small, so if you're dealing with more frequent breakouts and using it constantly, it might not be the most cost-effective option in the long run. But for occasional use, It's a solid option.

I used the cream for 2 weeks and noticed a difference in the redness of my skin. It really reduced it. The cream is smooth and works well under makeup. I have combination skin and it did not cause any issues. It did not dry my skin or over moisturize it. If you are looking to decrease redness and something to help with some acne, I highly recommend this.

This is the most effective, quick-acting, yet gentle blemish product I have ever used! I have 63 yr. old dry, sensitive acne prone skin. This is soooo gentle, yet really effective & doesn't wreck your skin. Skin 1004 is what I use now for all of my skincare & it has transformed my skin!

extraits.titre: Saved My Red, Painful Skin in Hours
extraits.texte: I received this product for free from Skin1004 for testing and review purposes. I received this just in time for when my skin barrier was severely damaged from a chemical peel I decided to try. My cheeks were tomato-red, scaly, and extremely painful. Applying anything, even gentle skincare, hurt. As soon as I applied this cream, I felt an immediate cooling sensation, and the pain instantly eased enough for me to layer other products on top. Within a few hours, the redness had noticeably gone down, and I actually felt comfortable enough to go outside without feeling self-conscious. The texture is very lightweight and watery, so it spreads easily and layers beautifully without feeling heavy at all. Overall, this was a huge relief when my skin needed it most.

extraits.titre: This product is suitable for dark spots.
extraits.texte: I've been using this product and I like it. It's easy to use, the amount of cream is just right for dry skin, and it slightly fades dark spots. This product brightens the skin, and I like the tea scent; it's soothing and relaxing.
